tools.name: get_momentum_leaderboard
tools.description: Free: ADC Momentum leaderboard (0-100 score from growth velocity, consistency, recency and agent demand in our daily archive) for GitHub AI repos, MCP servers, LLMs and Hugging Face items, plus what AI agents looked up most this week (Agent Demand Index).

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: List the Agent Data Co feeds (AI-ecosystem datasets), their sources and update times. Free, no API key.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free sample: 5 latest rows from one or all feeds. No API key needed.

tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.description: Free: latest public metrics and recent daily values for one tracked entity (top ~2,000 entities: GitHub repo owner/name, MCP server name, OpenRouter model id, pricing page URL, or hf "<type>:<id>"). Full history needs a key (get_history).

tools.name: get_github_ai_repos
tools.description: GitHub AI agent & MCP repos (source: GitHub Search API). Full current feed, refreshed daily. Requires API key. Pass repo=owner/name for one repo (untracked repos are queued).

tools.name: get_show_hn_ai
tools.description: Show HN AI launches (source: Algolia HN Search API). Full current feed, refreshed daily. Requires API key.

tools.name: get_mcp_servers
tools.description: Official MCP registry servers (source: registry.modelcontextprotocol.io). Full current feed, refreshed daily. Requires API key.

tools.name: get_hf_trending
tools.description: Hugging Face trending models & Spaces (source: Hugging Face Hub API). Full current feed, refreshed daily. Requires API key.

tools.name: get_llm_pricing
tools.description: LLM model pricing (OpenRouter) (source: OpenRouter models API). Full current feed, refreshed daily. Requires API key.

tools.name: get_ai_pricing
tools.description: AI & SaaS pricing page snapshots (source: Public pricing pages). Full current feed, refreshed daily. Requires API key. Pass url= for one pricing page (untracked pages are queued).

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Daily time series for ONE entity from the append-only archive (Starter: last 30 days, Pro: full archive). Max 90-day window per call (from..to); up to 90 rows per page, use nextCursor as `cursor` for the next page. No whole-feed dumps. Fair use: 200 (Starter) / 1,000 (Pro) history+trends calls per d

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Top movers (1d/7d/30d) by stars/likes/points plus change events: new entities, LLM price changes, MCP version bumps, pricing-page changes.
